author: ytilauxesomoh
body:
His old account was called Kaawaiii.

  1. Ban evasion is not permitted, with the exception of ban evading an innapropriate username punishment, and will result in a permanent ban on all accounts associated with the original Minecraft account.


https://avicus.net/kaawaiii#punishments

https://namemc.com/name/kaawaiii

Notice how he changed his name to RespectSosa several months after he was banned, this is because he was on a team called Stupeflip, with a player called SosaChamberlain_, who is also banned on avicus (https://avicus.net/sosastyle#punishments). He did this several months after he was already banned on avicus.

Respond if you have any questions :)
